{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline
print("\nDistribution of biomarker_baseline:")
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Check how many are exactly -999
n_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values: {n_neg999}")

# Check if these are all in the severe group
severe_neg999 = data[(data['severity'] == 'severe') & (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999)]
print(f"\nNumber of severe patients with -999 baseline: {len(severe_neg999)}")

# Also check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"\nNumber of unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of duplicates: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
duplicates = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple sample_seq: {duplicates['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Show highest sample_seq per patient_id
duplicates_sorted = duplicates.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False)
print(f"\nSample of patients with multiple sample_seq (highest seq first):\n{duplicates_sorted[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline']].head(5)}")"}
